record.name: External reference-price guard
record.summary: Bound actual pool price against two fresh, positive, same-numeraire reference feeds.

units.amounts: Explicit per-field raw currency units; no currency/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual v4 liquidity L, not token balances or dollar depth
units.time: Fields distinguish absolute UTC seconds, durations, block counts and Monday UTC weekly offsets
units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96
fields.label: Sqrt Price X96
fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1 / raw currency0); not display-token price
fields.help: Enter the raw-unit starting price. Check both token decimals before translating a display price.

fields.name: tokenDecimals0
fields.label: Token Decimals0
fields.units: currency0 decimals reported by actual token

fields.name: tokenDecimals1
fields.label: Token Decimals1
fields.units: currency1 decimals reported by actual token

fields.name: minimumAnswer0
fields.label: Minimum Answer0
fields.units: raw feed0 positive answer units; token decimals are not converted

fields.name: maximumAnswer0
fields.label: Maximum Answer0
fields.units: raw feed0 positive answer units; token decimals are not converted

fields.name: minimumAnswer1
fields.label: Minimum Answer1
fields.units: raw feed1 positive answer units; token decimals are not converted

fields.name: maximumAnswer1
fields.label: Maximum Answer1
fields.units: raw feed1 positive answer units; token decimals are not converted

fields.name: maximumDeviationPpm
fields.label: Maximum Deviation Ppm
fields.help: Deviation from the ratio of two configured common-numeraire reference answers; checked before and after actual execution.

fields.name: sequencerGraceSeconds
fields.label: Sequencer Grace Seconds
fields.help: Must be zero when uptime feed is zero; otherwise1–86400 seconds after sequencer recovery.

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code and exact-transfer semantics; no tax/rebase token, decimals or backing inferred.
Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code and exact-transfer semantics; no tax/rebase token, decimals or backing inferred.

Verify current feed code, positive complete rounds, exact declared decimals, common numeraire, freshness bounds and correct optional sequencer feed/recovery interpretation. No feed/pair catalogue or automatic provider admission is inferred.

definition.help: Reference feeds and tokens must report exact declared decimals0–18. Pool before/after checks do not prove external feed integrity or prevent all manipulation. No external feed is silently selected.
